name: SD: Tiered customer support (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A software company's support desk, counted every day: active customers, untriaged new tickets, the tier-1, tier-2 and engineering queues, the tier-2 agents on staff and their hiring budget, tickets resolved and waiting to close, and reopened tickets. Every tier-2 agent hired spends ten thousand dollars of the hiring budget (a co-flow), which is released at a limited pace, so when the team is told to grow the budget runs low and hiring slows. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the desk (the ground truth is in sd-support-tiers/truth.model.json, including a stock the desk does not count). Some changes to the team are announced as eras; others, like bad releases, are not. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
